traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The kobold has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold’s al- lies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: While in sunlight, the kobold has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: Trigger: The knight is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The knight adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. Kobold Kobold Warrior
